articles.title: Crypto IPO market stalls as capital rotates to AI and macro uncertainty weighs
articles.snippet: Funding constraints and investor caution, not regulation, are delaying crypto IPOs, according to Cohen & Company Capital Markets' Christian Lopez.

articles.title: AI found an Ethereum bug that could take validators offline, but humans had to prove it
articles.snippet: The Ethereum Foundation pointed coordinated AI agents at the software its validators run and got a remotely triggerable crash out of it. It also got a pile of confident, well-written findings that were not bugs at all.

articles.title: U.S. government digital dollar set to be banned tonight under housing law's CBDC limit
articles.snippet: Despite President Donald Trump's refusal to sign Congress' bipartisan housing bill, it's set to go into effect at midnight, and its temporary CBDC ban along with it.

articles.title: Ethereum climbs 3% on tokenization boom: Can bulls push ETH price past $1,800?
articles.snippet: Despite strong tokenization gains and institutional accumulation, weak onchain and derivatives data leaves ETH vulnerable to a $1,700 retest.

articles.title: DOJ moves to dismiss charges against alleged $722M BitClub fraudster: Report
articles.snippet: Matthew Goettsche was set to face trial in October for conspiracy to commit wire fraud and selling unregistered securities.
